title: AquaTrace Telemetry
description: Per-frame perception output: vision engine -> backend POST /ingest/telemetry

water_bbox.description: [x, y, w, h] in pixels of the largest water region

waterline_delta.description: frame-to-frame displacement in px; positive = water rising

flow_dir_deg.description: dominant optical-flow direction in degrees (0 = +x right, 90 = up-screen)

annotated_jpeg_b64.description: Optional base64 JPEG of the annotated frame (evidence snapshots)

frame_hash.description: Optional hash of the raw frame (frozen-frame detection)

captured_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC capture timestamp of the frame

stream_status.description: Optional stream health reported by the vision engine

reconnect_attempts.description: Optional count of consecutive reconnect attempts by the vision engine
